description: Cancel a running discovery job by its jobId, freeing its slot so a new find_prospects can start. Credits are refunded ONLY when the run had delivered zero prospects at cancel time; if prospects were already delivered you keep them and are not refunded (they stay retrievable via get_discovery_results). Only the job's owner may cancel; cancelling an already-finished job is a harmless no-op that returns its current state.
name: cancel_discovery
title: Cancel discovery
